evidence: Genesis 19:30-38, especially 19:36-38: Lot's elder daughter bore Moab and younger daughter bore Ben-ammi; their mother is not recorded as giving birth to them.
Pinned ACAI people/json/WifeOfLot.json source mistakenly lists the two grandsons as her direct offspring.
BRSI child records person:Moab and person:Ben-ammi already identify person:Daughter1OfLot and person:Daughter2OfLot respectively as their mothers.
editorial_field_changes.reason: The original source's offspring list conflates the two daughters' children with Lot's wife's own children. Retain daughters only; keep every person identity and original biblical word/ref witness unchanged.

bsi.editorial_reason: Genesis 19:36-38 identifies Lot's daughters, not his wife, as the mothers of Moab and Ben-ammi. Remove only these two inherited grandchild-to-parent links. All other fields remain source-unreviewed.
editorial_evidence: Pinned ACAI people/json/WifeOfLot.json and BRSI person:Moab/person:Ben-ammi mother links
